explication: Appsmith is an open-source low-code platform for creating custom business applications. The main user journey is to build an interface, connect it to data or services, configure and run operations, and use the resulting application. The tree and README also identify Git-based application workflows, import/export, and AI agents as product capabilities. Several backend and integration links are not demonstrated by the sampled excerpts, so those relationships are shown as unverified rather than asserted as observed calls.
